Confirmed the global-object-with-ctor route (CRect16/CVec3 matched __sinit_) does NOT apply: those TUs own their object slices and MWCC emits auto-__sinit_ inlining the ctor (li r3,obj@sda21; li r0,0; sth r0,obj@sda21(r0); sth r0,2(r3)...). The nand dest lbl_eu_806659E8 is retail-owned (monolibdata2.s; retail object has it U), so the TU cannot define it and must hand-write sinit_804DB0D8 as extern C free function. Tested 16+ MWCC versions (GC/1.3,2.0,2.5,2.6,2.7,3.0a3,3.0a3.2-3.4,3.0a5,3.0a5.2, Wii/1.0,1.0a,1.1,1.3,1.5,1.6,1.7) x -O4,p/-O4,s x -ipa file/off/program x 30+ source shapes (return-p, volatile, pragmas, goto, global object, static object, static member, static class member init, derived-class static, function-local static guard, placement-new, manual __ct__ tail call with named sbss symbol, inline helper): MWCC always folds to stw rX,dest@sda21(r0) (20 bytes) or tail-calls b __ct__ (CNand sinit_804DA4C0 shape). No combination emits b .+4 + unfolded stw r4,0(r3).
